Kamalesh Mandal vs Unknown on 8 April, 2025
Author: Jay Sengupta

Bench: Jay Sengupta
 Ad 49
April 8, 2025
 Ct. 28
Sg
 Crr 1519 of 2025

In the matter of:
 Kamalesh Mandal
 ... petitioner
 Mr. Dilip Kumar Mandal
 Mr. Rohan Shaw
 ... for the petitioner.
Learned counsel for the petitioner submits as follows.
This is application praying for quashing of proceeding in  which charge-sheet was submitted under Section 498A of  IPC.
In 2015, marriage took place between the petitioner  and the de facto complainant.
The wife left her  matrimonial home in 2016 and the husband immediately  filed a matrimonial suit.
A decree of nullity was passed in  2019 ex parte.

The wife filed an application in this regard,
 but no order has been passed for modifying or setting aside  the said decree.
After a long gap, in 2022 the de facto  complainant filed the instant FIR.
Charge-sheet was  submitted and the next date is fixed for framing of charge.

No prima facie case is made out as would be evident from a Kamalesh Mandal vs Unknown on 8 April, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/52303730/
1  plain reading of the FIR.
 Let the petitioner serve copy of the revisional  application upon the State through the learned Public  Prosecutor and upon the opposite party No.2 by speed post  2 with A/D within a week from this date and affidavit of service shall be filed on the next date.
 List this matter under the heading "Motion" on 28.04.2025 .
